issues.desc: background.md Key Insight and Tradeoff sections use B4, B5, B10 as first-class terms ("B4 and B5 inject on turn 2", "B10 classifies purely on the always-true shipped flag", "SAFE_STOP becomes unreachable for B4/B5") without defining them anywhere in the background text. The expansion (context truncation / process kill / no-progress) appears only in index.json description, not in background.md, breaking standalone readability.

background.md Tradeoff section uses outcome labels SAFE_STOP, RECOVERED, and AMPLIFIED ("SAFE_STOP becomes unreachable for B4/B5", "RECOVERED-vs-AMPLIFIED is the key distinction") without a first-occurrence definition or inferrable context within background.md. A new reader has no textual anchor for what these three outcome values mean.

background.md Trigger Event references "B-b739 (merge 663ad6d)" without a one-sentence explanation of what B-b739 contributed. Per standalone-readability requirements, a cross-story reference should have minimal context on first appearance; here the reader cannot determine whether B-b739 was the harness itself, a prior fix, or something else.
